q.en: Who wins the class spelling bee?
q.zh: 谁赢得了班级拼写比赛？

options.en: Josh, the boy who had won the bee the year before
options.zh: Josh，那个去年赢得比赛的男孩

explain.en: Jasmine spells 'apology' and 'arrogant' correctly and Mr. Russo announces her as the new class spelling champ.
explain.zh: Jasmine 正确地拼出了 'apology' 和 'arrogant'，Russo 老师宣布她成为班级新晋拼写冠军。

q.en: What word does Jasmine miss at the school-wide spelling bee?
q.zh: Jasmine 在学校拼写比赛中拼错了哪个单词？

options.en: competition, the word Jasmine spelled perfectly to win
options.zh: competition（比赛），Jasmine 拼对并因此夺冠的那个词

explain.en: Principal Lopez asks Jasmine to spell 'caterpillar.' She had never spelled it before and got it wrong, so she was out on her first word.
explain.zh: Lopez 校长让 Jasmine 拼 'caterpillar'。她以前从没拼过这个词，结果拼错了，所以在第一个词就被淘汰了。

q.en: What lesson does Jasmine learn by the end of the story?
q.zh: 到故事结尾，Jasmine 学到了什么道理？

options.zh: 对每个人来说拼写都很容易

options.en: It's okay to fail, but it's not okay to be mean
options.zh: 失败没关系，但刻薄地对待别人就不对
年纪大的学生总是会赢

options.en: Winning is the only thing that matters, and the champion wins a golden trophy taller than the school building
options.zh: 赢才是唯一重要的事，而且冠军会得到一座比教学楼还高的黄金奖杯

explain.en: Jasmine says, 'It's okay to fail, but it's not okay to be mean about it,' and 'You never know how others feel until you're in their shoes.'
explain.zh: Jasmine 说：'失败没关系，但刻薄地对待别人就不对'，而且'你不到别人的处境，就不知道别人的感受'。

options.en: Being very shy, which is exactly how Jasmine behaved when she lost
options.zh: 非常害羞，这正是 Jasmine 输掉比赛时的样子

options.en: Having the attitude that one is better than others
options.zh: 有一种觉得自己比别人强的态度

explain.en: The glossary defines 'arrogant' as 'having the attitude that one is better than others'—just how Jasmine acted at lunch.
explain.zh: 词汇表把 'arrogant' 定义为'有一种觉得自己比别人强的态度'——这正是 Jasmine 吃午餐时的样子。

q.en: Why does the author say Finn was 'glaring' at Jasmine during the bee?
q.zh: 作者为什么说在比赛时 Finn 正'怒视'着 Jasmine？

options.en: He was staring angrily at her because she had been mean
options.zh: 他在生气地盯着她，因为她之前很刻薄

options.en: He was cheering for her and clapping loudly because he was happy she won
options.zh: 他在为她欢呼，并大声鼓掌，因为对她获胜感到高兴

explain.en: When Jasmine's name was announced, 'He wasn't clapping. He seemed to be glaring at her'—staring angrily because of how she treated him.
explain.zh: 当念到 Jasmine 的名字时，'他没有鼓掌。他似乎在怒视着她'——因为她对 Finn 的态度，他在生气地盯着她。

q.en: Why did Jasmine lose at the school-wide bee?
q.zh: Jasmine 为什么会在全校比赛中输掉？

options.en: Finn gave her the wrong word on purpose because he was jealous and wanted to win himself
options.zh: Finn 给了她错误的词，是故意的，因为他嫉妒、想自己赢

options.en: She was too young to compete
She had not studied the word list and got a word she didn't know
options.zh: 她没有背单词表，抽到了一个不会拼的词

explain.en: Jasmine 'had not thought about the older students' and thought, 'Maybe I should have studied the list of words Mr. Russo gave the class.' She got 'caterpillar,' a word she'd never spelled.
explain.zh: Jasmine '没有想到要跟年纪更大的学生比赛'，并想'也许我应该背一下 Russo 老师给全班的单词表'。她抽到了 'caterpillar'，一个从没拼过的词。

q.en: How did Jasmine treat Finn after beating him in the class bee?
q.zh: 在班级比赛打败 Finn 之后，Jasmine 是怎么对待他的？

options.en: She ignored him completely and never spoke to him again after the contest
options.zh: 她完全不理他，比赛之后再也没跟他说过话

options.en: She was mean and acted like the words were easy
options.zh: 她很刻薄，装作那些词很简单

explain.en: Jasmine said, 'How hard is it to spell a few words?' and called the class words 'baby words,' then said 'See you guys L-A-T-E-R' in a smug way.
explain.zh: Jasmine 说：'拼几个词有多难？'还把班里的词叫作'幼稚的单词'，然后得意地说'回头见 L-A-T-E-R'。

q.en: What is the focus question of this story?
q.zh: 这个故事的聚焦问题是什么？

options.en: What is the lesson of this story?
options.zh: 这个故事的寓意是什么？

explain.en: The book's Focus Question is 'What is the lesson of this story?'—pointing readers to the moral about failure and kindness.
explain.zh: 书的聚焦问题是'这个故事的寓意是什么？'——引导读者思考关于失败与友善的道理。

q.en: How does Finn react when Jasmine apologizes to him?
q.zh: 当 Jasmine 向 Finn 道歉时，Finn 是什么反应？

options.en: He stays angry and walks away

explain.en: Finn sympathizes and says, 'It was really brave to go up against those older students,' showing he has forgiven her.
explain.zh: Finn 表示理解，并说'敢于和那些年纪大的学生比赛真的很勇敢'，说明他已经原谅了她。

q.en: What does Josh tell Jasmine that helps her realize she was wrong?
q.zh: Josh 对 Jasmine 说的什么话，让她意识到自己错了？

options.en: That Finn is smarter than her because he studies every night and gets straight A's
options.zh: 说 Finn 比她聪明，因为他每晚都学习，门门功课都得优

options.en: That she is the best speller
That 'apology' is a 'baby word' and second graders never win
options.zh: 说 'apology' 是个'幼稚的词'，而且二年级学生从没赢过

explain.en: Josh says 'apology? That's kind of a baby word, isn't it?' and 'Second graders never win the school-wide spelling bee,' making Jasmine blush and doubt herself.
explain.zh: Josh 说'apology？那算是个幼稚的词吧？'以及'二年级学生从没赢过全校拼写比赛'，让 Jasmine 脸红并开始怀疑自己。

prompt.en: Pretend you are Jasmine. Write an apology letter to Finn explaining why you are sorry and how you will treat others better in the future.
prompt.zh: 假设你是 Jasmine。写一封给 Finn 的道歉信，说明你为什么感到抱歉，以及将来你会如何更好地对待别人。

en: Jasmine was mean because she thought spelling was easy and called words 'baby words' (p. 7).
She changed after she failed at the school-wide bee and understood Finn's feelings.
Her lesson: 'It's okay to fail, but it's not okay to be mean about it.'
A good letter says sorry, names what she did, and promises to be kinder.
zh: Jasmine 很刻薄，因为她觉得拼写很简单，还把单词叫作'幼稚的单词'（第7页）。
她在全校比赛失败、理解了 Finn 的感受之后改变了。
她的教训是：'失败没关系，但刻薄地对待别人就不对。'
一封好的信会道歉、说明自己做了什么，并承诺更友善。
